title: Amorph
description: A Beatles portrait printed in sixty thousand dots of ink. Hold and it dissolves into drifting smoke from under your finger; let go and every dot curves across to the place in the next face that matches its tone, so John becomes Paul becomes George.
intent: Herb's Sand note built for real: pixels that flow to their closest matching tone in the next picture, with a graceful curved, staggered, soft-landing swap instead of a harsh one.
